placers.name: Hunter Lyle
placers.note: SCISA 106 #4 as a middle schooler, class of 2032. Profiles only for the classes of 2027-2030 (Matt, 21 Oct 2026); his profile was removed with his approval and comes back when he reaches high school. The placement and bouts stay.

notes: Six class years from the 31 Oct RankWrestlers addendum are held, not applied, because each one would put an 8th grader in an SCHSL championship. Cameron Daniels (Bamberg-Ehrhardt), Dylan Lawter (Belton-Honea Path), Jordan Washington (Battery Creek), Preston Hogan (Colleton County) and Preston Rozelle (Camden) all qualified in the 2025 SCHSL season, and the only evidence for each is a grade of 'Fr' read from his 2025-26 record - a freshman in 2025-26 was in 8th grade in 2024-25. Joey Clark (Waccamaw) is the same shape in reverse: the addendum reads '8th' in 2025-26 against the 2029 we already hold, which would make his 2026 SCHSL qualification an 8th grader's. Of 2,876 South Carolina rows, all 22 that sit before a freshman year are SCISA, the independent association that admits middle schoolers; not one is SCHSL. Six independent cases of the same one-year shape read as a systematic offset in how the grade is dated rather than as six unprecedented wrestlers, so they wait for a dated record from a placed season. The other 40 years from the pass were applied, SCISA's pre-freshman readings among them (31 Oct 2026).

702 of 766 state-qualifier keys (92%) still have no class year after the RankWrestlers pass, and that is the shape of the source rather than a gap to chase: RW's South Carolina coverage is deep for placers and ranked wrestlers and thin for the non-placer tail of small-school and SCISA qualifiers. Those rows keep a blank year and will fill through family claims and future seasons. SCMAT grades never set a year (31 Oct 2026).
